prompt: Operator: BatchNormV3 training-mode forward. x is [N,C,L]=[32,64,64] (float32); weight/bias are [C] (float32); eps=1e-5. For each channel c reduce over N and L: mean[c]=sum/(N*L), var[c]=sumsq/(N*L)-mean^2, invstd[c]=1/sqrt(var+eps); out[n,c,l]=(x-mean[c])*invstd[c]*weight[c]+bias[c]=x*scale[c]+shift[c]. Outputs: out [N,C,L], saveMean [C], saveInvStd [C]. Inputs MUST be torch.Tensor (numpy is silently zeroed on the C310 simulator path). Tiling: view x as [N*C, L]; partition C across CORE_NUM=8 cores, ch=8 channels/core; each core loads a [ch, L] strided tile per sample n (rows n*C+c0..), accumulates per-channel sum/sumsq via `asc2.reduce_sum(blk, 1)` (reduce the L axis -> [ch]); after the N loop compute mean/var/invstd ([ch] tiles, use asc2.rsqrt); load weight/bias [ch] slices; scale=w*invstd, shift=b-scale*mean; broadcast scale/shift via `asc2.broadcast_to(asc2.expand_dims(scale, 1), ch, L)`; second pass reloads each [ch,L] tile and stores x*scale+shift. Shape dims used in tile shapes must be literal ints (module constants), not ConstExpr (the shape validators reject ConstExpr). Accumulator: float32. Tolerance: mean/invstd atol=rtol=1e-3, out atol=rtol=1e-2 vs a torch fp64 reference. Platform: Ascend950PR_9599. Build/run: python3.11 kernel.py -r Model -v Ascend950PR_9599.
